Operating Model & Reporting Individual contributor role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; supports functional delivery of subsurface use cases from discovery to deployment. Works closely with upstream business teams (subsurface, production interface points) and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects). Reports to Senior Manager / Manager – Subsurface (O&G Upstream) and supports Consulting Delivery Leadership priorities for SC&O / Digital Ops engagements. Key Responsibilities Subsurface Use Case Discovery & Functional Support Support discovery workshops with subsurface stakeholders to capture decision workflows, value drivers, pain points, uncertainties, and success criteria. Support domain inputs across upstream analytics / AI solution areas such as: Reservoir performance analytics and forecasting Production surveillance / optimization linkages Well performance diagnostics and root cause analysis Decline analysis and anomaly detection Field development planning decision support Review and validate analytics / AI outputs and dashboards for domain realism and engineering alignment; escalate concerns and recommendations to the Manager. Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery Engage with subsurface teams, production interface stakeholders, and technical teams to gather structured feedback and convert it into actionable requirements/backlog items. Governance, Quality & Assurance Support definition and application of data quality checks, engineering assumptions, and validation checkpoints for subsurface datasets and model outputs. Required Experience & Qualifications 3–6 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong subsurface depth (Reservoir / Production / Petroleum Engineering). Practical understanding of subsurface workflows (not theory-only), including uncertainty handling and data quality considerations. Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate engineering concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams. Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning engineering / operations / digital teams. Fluency in English (mandatory). Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts. Familiarity with engineering / digital tools (surveillance systems, production databases, BI tools). Arabic language capability (optional).

description:
Job Summary Role Overview: We are seeking a dedicated ServiceNow Developer for a 6-month engagement starting in August. This role focuses exclusively on the One-Stop project, where the developer will play a critical part in enhancing and adopting our ServiceNow platforms out-of-the-box third-party risk management capabilities. The primary objectives will be enabling the DDR module and executing enhancements to the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) ecosystem, including external-facing portals. Responsibilities Module Enablement: Enable, configure and test the DDR (Due Diligence Request) module. Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM): Execute updates to the TPRM module to align with business requirements. Profile Management: Build and configure robust Third-Party Profiles to accurately capture and assess vendor data. External Portal Development: Develop and enhance the Third-Party Risk Portal, ensuring a secure and intuitive interface for external vendors. Platform Automation & Scripting: Design and implement automated processes using Flow Designer, and write efficient server-side logic using Business Rules/Script Actions/Events. Event Management: Configure and trigger Script Actions and platform Events to drive background processing. Targeted Communications: Design and configure complex, condition-driven system Notifications tailored to specific internal and external stakeholders. Security & Access Control: Implement strict data governance by designing and maintaining complex Access Control Lists (ACLs) across affected tables. Required Qualifications Experience: A minimum of 2 years of proven and hands-on experience in ServiceNow administration and platform configuration. Certification: Active ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification is required. Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of ServiceNow security models, specifically troubleshooting ACLs. This is a must have for the candidate. Proven proficiency building automated processes in Flow Designer. Strong scripting capabilities, specifically with Business Rules, Script Actions, and the Event Registry. Experience configuring dynamic, targeted system Notifications. Preferred Qualifications An active ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification is highly desired but not required. Prior experience working directly with the Vendor Risk Management (VRM) or Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) applications. Experience configuring Service Portal pages and widgets for external users.
